faq.q: Who won the first World Cup?
faq.a: Uruguay hosted and won the first FIFA World Cup in 1930, beating Argentina 4 to 2 in the final. Only 13 teams took part.
asks: When was the first World Cup?

faq.q: When did the Women's World Cup start?
faq.a: The first FIFA Women's World Cup was held in China in 1991, and the USA won it.

faq.q: How many teams play in the World Cup?
faq.a: From 2026 there are 48 teams in the men's finals, up from 32. The 2026 tournament is hosted by Canada, Mexico and the USA.
asks: How many countries play in the World Cup?

faq.q: Which country has won the most World Cups?
faq.a: Brazil has won the men's World Cup five times: 1958, 1962, 1970, 1994 and 2002.
asks: Who has the most World Cups?

faq.q: How often is the World Cup held?
faq.a: Every four years. It was not held in 1942 and 1946 because of the Second World War.

facts: Uruguay hosted and won the first FIFA World Cup in 1930 with 13 teams taking part.
The first FIFA Women's World Cup was held in China in 1991.
The 2026 World Cup is the first with 48 teams.
